title: Celestial Patron
contents: subtitle | Call on the Power of the Heavens
text | Your pact draws on the Upper Planes, the realms of everlasting bliss. You might enter an agreement with an empyrean, a couatl, a sphinx, a unicorn, or another heavenly entity.
text | Your pact allows you to experience a hint of the holy light that illuminates the multiverse.
footer|Warlock|subclass|Celestial

title: Celestial Spells
contents: section | Celestial Spells
text | These spells are always prepared once you reach the indicated level.
rule
description | Level 3 | Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light, Sacred Flame
description | Level 5 | Daylight, Revivify
description | Level 7 | Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire
description | Level 9 | Greater Restoration, Summon Celestial
footer|Warlock|subclass|Celestial

title: Healing Light
contents: subtitle | Bonus Action | 60 ft
text | You gain a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your Warlock level.
text | As a Bonus Action, heal yourself or a creature within 60 feet, expending dice from the pool (max number of dice = your Charisma modifier).
text | Roll the expended dice and restore HP equal to the total. Regain all dice on a Long Rest.
footer|Warlock|subclass|Celestial

title: Radiant Soul
contents: text | You have Resistance to Radiant damage.
text | Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant or Fire damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to the damage dealt to one target of that spell.
footer|Warlock|subclass|Celestial
